question: List all subcategories that have products from exactly 3 different brands, ordered by their parent category names.
gold_sql: SELECT c2.name FROM categories c1 JOIN categories c2 ON c1.category_id = c2.parent_category_id JOIN products p ON c2.category_id = p.category_id GROUP BY c2.category_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT brand) = 3 ORDER BY c1.name;
pred_sql:
SELECT c1.name AS parent_category, c2.name AS child_category
FROM categories c1
JOIN categories c2 ON c1.category_id = c2.parent_category_id
JOIN products p ON c1.category_id = p.category_id
GROUP BY c1.name, c2.name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.brand) = 3
ORDER BY c1.name;
raw_output:
SELECT c1.name AS parent_category, c2.name AS child_category
FROM categories c1
JOIN categories c2 ON c1.category_id = c2.parent_category_id
JOIN products p ON c1.category_id = p.category_id
GROUP BY c1.name, c2.name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.brand) = 3
ORDER BY c1.name;

question: Calculate the average rating for each product by category, excluding categories with an average rating lower than 3.
gold_sql: WITH category_product_ratings AS ( SELECT c.category_id, p.product_id, AVG(r.rating) AS avg_rating FROM categories c JOIN products p ON c.category_id = p.category_id JOIN reviews r ON p.product_id = r.product_id GROUP BY c.category_id, p.product_id ), avg_category_ratings AS ( SELECT category_id, AVG(avg_rating) AS avg_category_rating FROM category_product_ratings GROUP BY category_id ) SELECT apr.category_id, apr.product_id, apr.avg_rating FROM category_product_ratings apr JOIN avg_category_ratings acr ON apr.category_id = acr.category_id WHERE apr.avg_rating >= acr.avg_category_rating;
pred_sql:
SELECT c.name AS category, AVG(r.rating) as avg_rating
FROM categories c
JOIN products p ON c.category_id = p.category_id
LEFT JOIN reviews r ON p.product_id = r.product_id
GROUP BY c.name
HAVING AVG(r.rating) >= 3.0;
raw_output:
SELECT c.name AS category, AVG(r.rating) as avg_rating
FROM categories c
JOIN products p ON c.category_id = p.category_id
LEFT JOIN reviews r ON p.product_id = r.product_id
GROUP BY c.name
HAVING AVG(r.rating) >= 3.0;

gold_sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', payment_date) AS month, SUM(amount) AS total_amount, SUM(SUM(amount)) OVER (ORDER BY payment_date) AS cumulative_amount FROM payments WHERE strftime('%Y', payment_date) = '2024' GROUP BY month ORDER BY month;

question: Identify customers who have made purchases from more than 3 different categories and list their details.
gold_sql: SELECT c.customer_id, first_name, last_name FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY c.customer_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.category_id) > 3;
